map.：单张面积=700×1000/1e6=0.7 m²。单张用墨=0.7×30%×1: : Sheet area = 700x1000/1e6 = 0.7 m2. Ink per sheet = 0.7x30%x1.0x4 = 0.84 g. Net ink for the run = 0.84x5000 = 4200 g, with 5% waste = 4410 g = 4.41 kg, cost = 4.41x80 = 352.8 CNY, ink per thousand sheets 0.882 kg. If coverage rises to 50%, ink per sheet rises to 1.4 g and the run total to 7.35 kg; ink consumption grows roughly linearly with coverage.
map.这个工具和「油墨量（按覆盖率）」有何区别？: How does this tool differ from the "ink amount (by coverage)" one?
map.两者都是油墨估算，但口径不同：本工具直接以上墨量 g/m²（实地满版单位面积耗墨: Both estimate ink, but on different bases: this tool directly multiplies ink coverage in g/m2 (ink consumed per unit area for a solid full plate) by area and number of colors, suited to processes with a known ink standard; the other uses ink film thickness (um) x density, better when starting from coating physical parameters. The results cross-check each other; the difference comes from how the solid ink layer is modeled.
map.上墨量 g/m² 一般取多少？: What value is usually used for ink coverage in g/m2?
map.单色实地上墨量常见 1.0~1.5 g/m²，网点印刷因覆盖率低实际远低于此；专: Single-color solid ink coverage is commonly 1.0~1.5 g/m2; halftone printing is far below this because coverage is low, while a solid spot color can reach 2~3 g/m2. It is affected by screen ruling, blanket pressure and paper absorbency, so use actual proof measurements as the basis; the tool value is only a first estimate.
